data.name: Kamran
data.gender_notes: Kamran is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Persian kām, 'desire, wish', + rān, 'driving' — 'prosperous, successful'. Its root is Persian kām + rān. A Persian and Urdu given name. Kamran is a Persian name meaning “Prosperous; successful; fortunate”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kamran expresses “Prosperous; successful; fortunate”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Persian kām, 'desire, wish', + rān, 'driving' — 'prosperous, successful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamran total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
